website.note: www.ginkgobioworks.com — synthetic biology / cell programming platform; no proprietary clinical pipeline page

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Ginkgo Bioworks is a horizontal cell-programming and biosecurity platform company. Its business model is partner-funded R&D services and downstream value share (milestones/royalties on partners' products); it does not develop or own clinical-stage drug candidates. Pipeline-section text contains zero 'clinical trial', 'product candidate', 'phase 1/2/3', or NCT references. ClinicalTrials.gov returns zero P1-P3 trials sponsored by Ginkgo Bioworks.

excluded_partner_owned.note: Any therapeutic assets developed using Ginkgo's services platform are owned and trial-sponsored by partner pharma/biotech customers, not by Ginkgo. Per scope rules these are excluded.
